answer: What survives to the lotus is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the nebula of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the prism re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch, rewards vest against future work.
